celeborn.name: Celeborn
celeborn.title: Lord of Lothlorien
celeborn.born: Sometime during the Years of the Trees
celeborn.bio: Celeborn is the Lord of Lothlorien. He rules Lothlorien with his wife Galadriel.

earendil.name: Earendil
earendil.title: Mariner
earendil.bio: Earendil was descended from all Three Houses of the Edain, he was the first known person to reach Aman in the First Age after the Noldor went into exile.

elwing.name: Elwing
elwing.title: Elwing the White
elwing.died: Elwing was given a white tower in Valinor northward upon the borders of the Sundering Seas, and there she helped seabirds that came to her windows.
elwing.bio: Earendil was descended from all Three Houses of the Edain, he was the first known person to reach Aman in the First Age after the Noldor went into exile.

elrond.name: Elrond
elrond.title: Lord of Rivendell
elrond.bio: Elrond is the loremaster and lord of Rivendell, one of the key keepers of the Elder Days within Middle-earth.

elros.name: Elros
elros.title: First Lord of Numenor
elros.bio: Elros founded the realm of Numenor and was its first king.

galadriel.name: Galadriel
galadriel.title: Lady of Lothlorien
galadriel.born: Around 1362 of the Years of the Trees
galadriel.bio: Galadriel is the oldest elf in Middle-earth at the time of the War of the Ring. She rules Lothlorien with her husband Celeborn.

celebrian.name: Celebrian
celebrian.title: Lady of Rivendell
celebrian.bio: Celebrian is the daughter of Galadriel and Celeborn, and the wife of Elrond.

arador.name: Arador
arador.title: 14th Chieftain of the Dunedain, father to Arathorn II
arador.bio: Arador is the father of Arathorn II and part of the northern heir line of Isildur.

gilraen.name: Gilraen
gilraen.title: Gilraen the Fair
gilraen.bio: Gilraen the Fair was a Dúnadan of the North, the daughter of Dírhael and Ivorwen, and a descendant of the first chieftain, Aranarth.

aragorn_second.name: Aragorn II Elessar
aragorn_second.title: King of the Reunited Kingdom
aragorn_second.bio: Aragorn, son of Arathorn, is the heir of Isildur and becomes King Elessar after the War of the Ring.

arathorn_second.name: Arathorn II
arathorn_second.title: 15th Chieftain of the Dunedain, father to Aragorn II Elessar
arathorn_second.bio: Arathorn II was the fifteenth Chieftain of the Dúnedain and succeeded his father, Arador, when he was killed in 2930.

arwen.name: Arwen Undomiel
arwen.title: Queen of the Reunited Kingdom
arwen.bio: Arwen, daughter of Elrond and Celebrian, chooses a mortal life and becomes queen beside Aragorn.

eldarion.name: Eldarion
eldarion.title: Heir of Aragorn and Arwen
eldarion.bio: Eldarion is the son and heir of Aragorn and Arwen, continuing the reunited royal line into the Fourth Age.

unknown_daughters.name: Unknown Daughters
unknown_daughters.title: Unnamed daughters of Aragorn and Arwen
unknown_daughters.bio: This aggregate record stands in for Aragorn and Arwen's daughters, who are mentioned but not named in the published legendarium.

all_lineages.label: Elves and Men
all_lineages.description: The combined Men and Elven branches currently modeled around Aragorn, Arwen, and Elrond's house.
